sentence: This project uses underwater robots powered by artificial intelligence to count rare corals and study their risk of extinction.
This project supports a national network of university sites that give open access to nanoscale fabrication and characterization facilities.
This project supports travel to a symposium about computer security and electronic privacy.
This project studies ecosystem change and resilience, the ecology of human well-being, and the functions of biodiversity.
This project builds a transgenic toolkit to find out what genes do in cactus-breeding fly species.
This project uses computer modeling and experiments to study how catalyst structures change during reactions that make ammonia.
This project adds robotic equipment for computer numerically controlled machining and updates the curriculum around it.
This project studies how proteins put together the capsid shell of a virus that infects bacteria and keeps it stable.
This project builds a method that uses electromagnetic waves to detect cracks and pores inside metal parts during manufacturing.
This project builds a virtual reality environment that uses artificial intelligence to teach sustainable construction in a way that fits each person.
This project studies the genetic correlation between male calling behavior and female mate choice in a cricket species.
This project builds a graph neural network method to work out what long non-coding RNA molecules do.
This project builds a computational model of how a cluster of cells moves through the fruit fly ovary in response to chemical signals.
This project develops hexagonal boron nitride nanosheets that are thermally conductive and electrically insulating for advanced chip packaging.
This project tests whether ball-shaped molecules made of carbon atoms explain mysterious features in starlight.
This project builds a system that uses sensors and models to study when levees fail and how flooding spreads behind them.
